project_type: Python 3.13 backend (Strands Agents SDK 1.63.0 multi-agent app, pydantic models, httpx weather provider). No frontend yet.
build_system: setuptools via pyproject.toml, installed editable into .venv. No build step; tests are the verification.
test_framework: pytest 9.2.0 (+pytest-asyncio, respx). Offline agent tests use backend/tests/scripted_model.py ScriptedModel, which replays real Strands stream events.
test_command: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest   (run from d:\github work\SDK workshop\heatwise-ai; baseline 70 passed, 3 deselected). Live: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -m live -k <name> -s
verification_instructions: 1) From d:\github work\SDK workshop\heatwise-ai run the focused test file for the module changed, then the full suite; it must stay green offline (no network, no AWS). 2) Live Bedrock/Open-Meteo calls only for the single opt-in live test and the one CLI demo run in FEAT-003. 3) Every threshold or guidance source must be backed by a page actually fetched (web_fetch) during this work, recorded in backend/guidance/sources.py with URL and verified_on; PDFs cannot be read by web_fetch, so skip them rather than cite unread.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Not a git repo: work in place, no worktree, no commits, no pushes. Use absolute paths; the workspace root is d:\github work\SDK workshop and the project is the heatwise-ai subfolder. Do not modify AWS resources. Pin any new dependency exactly in pyproject.toml (none expected). Do not break the 70 existing offline tests.
contribution_requirements: Spec in d:\github work\SDK workshop\.kiro\specs\heatwise-ai\{requirements,design,tasks}.md must be kept in sync (tasks 2.1-2.6 checked with findings, design.md updated for decisions). Never invent URLs, programme names, thresholds or emergency numbers; unverifiable values become clearly labelled configurable project heuristics. No external actions (no alerts, no contacting third parties). No medical inference about individuals. Keep structured-output schemas small and flat (strings, nullable numbers) because Nova 2 Lite mis-types list fields; build lists in code; structured_output_attempts=2; always a deterministic fallback.
key_patterns: Specialist agent pattern = backend/agents/weather_agent.py: class with settings/model injection, lazy build_bedrock_model, _build_agent() -> (Agent, GuardrailHook, EvidenceLedgerHook), Agent(name, description, model, tools, system_prompt, hooks, structured_output_model, callback_handler=None), invoked with limits={'turns': n, 'structured_output_attempts': 2}, exceptions caught, result assembled from ledger records by a pure build_* function, model text diffed against data and replaced by a deterministic_* fallback, last_trace/last_blocked, as_tool() @tool closure returning model_dump_json(). Tools = build_*_tools(...) closures; errors returned via tool_error() from backend/tools/weather_tools.py. Steering: subclass strands.vended_plugins.steering.SteeringHandler, async steer_before_tool(*, agent, tool_use, **kwargs) returning Proceed/Guide; pass via Agent(plugins=[...]). Skills: strands.AgentSkills(skills=[dir]) via plugins; its tool is named 'skills'. Coordinator uses Agent(tool_executor=strands.tools.executors.SequentialToolExecutor()). Tests: settings fixture in conftest.py, FakeProvider in fakes.py, ScriptedModel(turns) with tool_call()/text().
directory_structure: heatwise-ai/backend/{agents (weather_agent, hooks, model_factory; M2 adds risk_agent, planner_agent, safety_agent, coordinator), tools (weather_tools; M2 adds risk_tools, planning_tools, verification_tools), models (weather, trace; M2 adds risk, plan, verification, report), services (weather/, validation; M2 adds risk_rules, claims), guidance (new: sources.py, catalog.py), skills (new: three SKILL.md dirs), tests, config.py, cli.py}. Paths in relevant_files are relative to d:\github work\SDK workshop.
